meta.description: Registry for recursive instability, divergence, collapse, drift, and nontermination failure modes in Phase 3.

failure_modes.name: recursive_divergence
failure_modes.description: System state grows without bound under iteration.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion
failure_modes.description: Unconstrained branch generation prevents stable termination or analysis.

failure_modes.name: symbolic_reduction_loop
failure_modes.description: Symbolic rewrite rules result in an infinite cyclic sequence.

failure_modes.name: nonterminating_reduction_chain
failure_modes.description: Reduction fails to reach a normal form within declared step limits.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_overcollapse
failure_modes.description: Loss of required process distinction during equivalence merging.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_undercollapse
failure_modes.description: Failure to merge equivalent states leads to resource exhaustion or non-convergence.

failure_modes.name: transport_closure_loss
failure_modes.description: NavT maps states outside of all admissible domains.

failure_modes.name: orientation_drift_accumulation
failure_modes.description: Orientation mismatch grows persistently under recursive transport.

failure_modes.name: residue_drift_accumulation
failure_modes.description: Residue states deviate persistently from stable basins under iteration.

failure_modes.name: reconstruction_ambiguity_explosion
failure_modes.description: Preimage uncertainty grows non-linearly under recursion.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_window_collapse
failure_modes.description: Admissibility domain shrinks to an empty set under perturbation.

failure_modes.name: theorem_condition_failure_under_perturbation
failure_modes.description: A theorem assumption is violated when formal conditions are perturbed.
